proposedTarget: Model both fields as `S.OptionFromOptionalKey(S.String).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` (or direct `S.withConstructorDefault(Effect.succeed(O.none()))`). Effect v4 `S.OptionFromOptionalKey` verified at `.repos/effect-v4/packages/effect/src/Schema.ts:8668`; repo exemplar: `packages/foundation/modeling/lexical/src/Lexical.model.ts:687-688`.
